name: Mark "LargeCardinal" Carney
biography: Mark is a mathematician and Quantum Hacker. Working at the bleeding edge of technology for two decades, he- a has presented on an array of topics stemming from his work on quantum information, machine learning, cryptography and cybersecurity data science. He has presented at major conferences around the world and his work was recently nominated for Innovation of the Year at the SANS Difference Makers Awards. Mark co-founded Quantum Village.
